Subject: RE: Peak Analytics onboarding — W-8BEN-E check

Folks,

I reviewed the W-8BEN-E. Two quick items from finance:
1) The name on the W-8BEN-E (Peak Analytics Limited) needs to match the vendor name on the bank account we will be paying. Can Peak confirm the payee name and the IBAN/Swift that will be used?
2) Because they have no US EIN, we need either a certificate of residence from Irish Revenue or a notarized declaration confirming foreign status for tax treaty purposes. The signed W-8 alone is acceptable for withholding purposes, but our payment platform also flags non-US payees without a residency cert.

Kimberly — any minimum language we should request on the residency cert? If you prefer, we can ask Peak for a bank statement with the company name and masked account number as secondary proof.

Once we have one of those items we can complete the internal TIN crosscheck and clear PO creation.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Accountant — Redwood Inference
